sources.name: Open Food Facts ingredients taxonomy
sources.note: Used only to confirm that most of these oil names exist as ingredients. Canonical strings there include soya oil, canola oil, rapeseed oil, corn oil, cottonseed oil, sunflower oil, safflower oil, grape seed oil, rice bran oil, vegetable oil, palm oil, and palm kernel oil. It does not assign the moderate concern. maize oil and the closed spelling grapeseed oil are dining-label synonyms kept in this file. The raw taxonomy is not vendored.
